# Supplementary Table 2: the closed form is an upper bound on the exact rank.
# Spectrum lambda_j = exp(-alpha j), j = 0..n-1. r_exact is enumerated from the
# cumulative tail; r_closed = (1/(2 alpha)) ln[ 1 / (eps^2 (1 - e^{-2 alpha n})) ].
# The closed form resolves the criterion with an infinite geometric tail, so it
# never asks for fewer modes than the enumeration.
